title: Copilot Studio: interactive MCP apps render inside agent conversations
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents a preview Microsoft Graph operation for blocking catalog packages, including MCP servers, but the controls table reports no automation. The data policy path also omits environment selection; the roadmap facts, billing statements and app behaviour otherwise match the sources checked.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans inline interactive UI when a Copilot Studio agent calls a UI-enabled tool on a compatible MCP server.
claims.quote: When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation.

claims.claim: The roadmap gives sortable tables and drilldowns as examples.
claims.quote: interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation

claims.claim: The roadmap describes MCP Apps as an extension of Model Context Protocol.
claims.quote: using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a plain-text fallback for surfaces that cannot render the UI.
claims.quote: A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI

claims.claim: An organisation can block an MCP server at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Registry > MCP server > Block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > Tools, and then select the Registry tab.
Select an MCP server from the list to open its overview pane.
Select Block to restrict the server across your organization

claims.claim: Automation for blocking an MCP server in the organisational catalog is not documented.
claims.quote: A package represents an agent or a tool, such as a plugin, MCP server, or skill, in the organization catalog.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api null with kind graph, call 'POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackage-block. Add to this row's note: 'Preview API; production use is not supported. Requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence and delegated CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All permission; no request body.' The overview explicitly includes MCP server packages and lists the block operation; the operation reference supplies this exact beta request.

claims.claim: Blocking an MCP server disables all tools it exposes.
claims.quote: Blocking an MCP server disables all the tools it exposes.

claims.claim: Effects on dependent plugins and linked connectors depend on the management route.
claims.quote: Effects on dependent plugins and linked connectors depend on the applicable management route. Don't assume the policy applies across all products or connected components.

Select Next.
If you're a tenant admin, or an environment admin for multiple environments, the Define scope page opens.
Select Next.
Review your policy, and then select Create policy if you're creating a new policy or Update policy if you're editing an existing policy.
